name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.introduce.SpeechVoiceCouponIntroduceActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects a coupon introduction. It shows the coupon promotion and lets the user continue to its offer.
disableEffect: The coupon ad and its claim/download route will no longer open.
